'''Ghoel''' was a [[Wol Cabasshite/Legends|Wol Cabasshite]] who, by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], was mistakenly left behind in the [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Unable to move from his perch on the walls of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] audience chamber, he used his long, prehensile tongue to lick newcomers to the palace. Although Ghoel was highly [[Sentience/Legends|intelligent]], every member of Jabba's court was ignorant of that fact. He was present in the chamber when Jabba organized a [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|trip]] to Tatooine's [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] with the intent of [[Death/Legends|executing]] several [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]].

==Biography==
[[File:GhoelJabbasPalace.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Ghoel resided in Jabba's palace.]]
Ghoel was a highly [[Sentience/Legends|intelligent]] [[Wol Cabasshite/Legends|Wol Cabasshite]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Members of his<ref name="Who's Who" /> [[Mollusk/Legends|mollusk]]-like<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars (Hasbro toy line)|pack=Jabba's Palace Court Denizens|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/sw04ultradenizens.asp}}</ref> [[Species/Legends|species]] rarely moved of their own accord,<ref name="Who's Who" /> and by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Ghoel was left behind and became an immobile<ref name="CCG" /> resident of<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|338|Ghoel}}</ref> the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="CSWE" /><ref name="CSWE Jabba">{{CSWECite|II|130|Jabba the Hutt (Jabba Desilijic Tiure)}}</ref> He clung to the walls,<ref name="Hasbro" /> rafters, and arches<ref name="CSWE" /> of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] audience chamber and often gave newcomers to the palace exploratory licks with his long, prehensile tongue.<ref name="Hasbro" /> Although such direct contact allowed Wol Cabasshites to communicate with members of other species,<ref name="DB">{{DB|species|wolcabasshite|Wol Cabasshite}}</ref> all of Jabba's henchmen were ignorant of Ghoel's intelligence.<ref name="Who's Who" />

Ghoel was in the audience chamber in 4 ABY when several members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] came to the palace to [[Rescue of Han Solo/Legends|rescue]] their friend [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who had been [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|frozen]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] and hung on the chamber's wall. When the Rebel [[General/Legends|General]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] arrived and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Jabba's pet [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|rancor]], the Hutt sentenced Skywalker, along with a now-unfrozen Solo and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], to be [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|thrown]] into the [[Tooth/Legends|jaws]] of a [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] that nested in Tatooine's [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]]. As the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] translated the crime lord's [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] edict into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]],<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> Ghoel attempted to lick the droid's head.<ref name="Who's Who" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:WolCabasshite1.jpg|thumb|right|230px|Ghoel the Wol Cabasshite]]
Like most members of his species,<ref name="DB" /> Ghoel possessed an advanced intellect.<ref name="Who's Who" /> However, he was unable to move during his [[Time/Legends|time]] in Jabba's Palace,<ref name="CCG" /> and none of the Hutt's henchmen were aware of his intelligence.<ref name="Who's Who" /> Ghoel had [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], grayish-pink skin,<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> and a long, grasping tongue, the last of which he used to lick new arrivals to the palace.<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The 'alien on the ceiling,' Ghoel is a snail-like parasite with an incredibly long tongue. He tries to lick Threepio as the droid begins his execution edict with the line, 'His High Exaltedness, the great Jabba the Hutt&hellip;'|"''Who's Who in Jabba's Palace''"|<ref name="Who's Who" />}}
[[File:GhoelConstruction.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Construction of the Ghoel puppet]]
The character who would eventually be known as Ghoel was created as a background [[Alien/Legends|alien]] for the Jabba's Palace scene of [[Richard Marquand]]'s [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. [[Industrial Light & Magic]]'s creature department constructed the alien puppet,<ref name="Behind the Magic">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> and puppeteer [[Mike Quinn]] performed the character on the film's set. Ghoel was originally set to lick C-3PO during [[Wikipedia:Close-up|close-up shots]] of the two characters, but Marquand felt that it would be too distracting and accordingly asked Quinn to keep the puppet's tongue stationary. Ghoel's tongue can still be seen moving in several [[Wikipedia:Long shot|wide shots]], which were filmed prior to the close-ups.<ref name="Quinn">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsinterviews1|url=2010/01/mike-quinn-interview.html|name=Star Wars Interviews|text=Mike Quinn interview: Nien Nunb: Star Wars}}</ref>

Ghoel's species was named in [[1983]] as part of the [[Airfix]] "Jabba The Hutt Throne Room Action Scene" kit,<ref name="Airfix">{{YouTube|video=UDZOS0VN3I0|text=Star Wars - Jabba The Hutt's Throne Room Action Scene|channel=channel/UC46dvMq4StKTGg3WjVTCaGg|name=actionjackman}}</ref> but Ghoel himself went unnamed until [[1995]], when the ''[[Jabba's Palace Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] coined "Ghoel."<ref name="CCG" /> Ghoel has since been mentioned in several additional [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] sources, some of which have incorrectly identified "Wol Cabasshite" as the character's name.<ref name="Hasbro" /><ref name="Behind the Magic" />
